daily_summary: 当日变更涵盖多个方向：(1) 注意力/推理正确性修复：FlashInfer prefill LSE 从 base-2 对数域转换为自然对数域以正确合并 DCP 结果，结构化输出在 reasoning end 后避免虚假 FSM 错误；(2) 新硬件后端：为 NVIDIA SM120 新增 b12x FP4 MoE 后端，为 XPU 新增 INC int4 w4a8 线性层后端；(3) 推测解码：新增 DFlash2（局部卷积 + candidate selector），并在 SM90 上启用 DSv4 adaptive verification；(4) 模型支持：Kimi-K3 支持 NVFP4 checkpoint 和 GEMM-AR 模式；(5) 多模态处理大重构：ProcessorInputs 移除文本组件（prompt 统一为 token 列表，删除 tokenization_kwargs，_call_hf_processor 签名变更）；(6) 若干 bugfix：LoRA punica int32 溢出、batch-invariant fp32 matmul OOR、确定性 MoE combine、tower connector LoRA 能力标志；(7) Rust 前端构建用纯 Rust 的 protox 替代外部 protoc。

affected_interfaces: vllm_ascend/worker/v2/spec_decode/__init__.py — init_speculator(): upstream vllm/v1/worker/gpu/spec_decode/__init__.py now dispatches DFlash2DraftModel → DFlash2Speculator, but vllm-ascend's own init_speculator only checks use_dflash()/use_dspark()/mtp/eagle and would silently return AscendDFlashSpeculator for a DFlash2 draft (the exact silent-degradation failure mode the commit's VllmConfig comment describes).

vllm_ascend/worker/v2/spec_decode/dflash/speculator.py — AscendDFlashSpeculator is the established DFlash1 pattern; DFlash2 needs an analogous AscendDFlash2Speculator subclassing the new upstream DFlash2Speculator (vllm/v1/worker/gpu/spec_decode/dflash2/speculator.py) that overrides build_draft_attn_metadatas/_update_draft_attn_metadata/init_cudagraph_manager/set_attn/propose and adapts the new triton kernels (_selector_walk_kernel, _cache_draft_logits_kernel) for NPU.

vllm_ascend/worker/v2/spec_decode/dflash/aclgraph.py — DFlashAclGraphManager (extends DFlashCudaGraphManager) must be extended for DFlash2's new full-graph buffers (selector scores _selector_scores, _cached_candidate_ids, _anchor_indices, candidate_ids) so run_fullgraph/update_full_graph_params update them.

vllm_ascend/patch/worker/patch_v2/patch_dflash_speculator.py — the monkey-patch that rebinds upstream DFlashCudaGraphManager=DFlashAclGraphManager and dflash.cudagraph.build_attn_metadata only targets the dflash module; it must also cover the new dflash2.speculator module (DFlash2Speculator inherits init_cudagraph_manager from DFlashSpeculator, so the base patch applies only if dflash2 imports the patched dflash module).

vllm_ascend/worker/v2/sample/gumbel.py — upstream refactored gumbel_block_argmax, extracting the new gumbel_noised_argmax used by DFlash2's _selector_walk_kernel; the NPU gumbel_sample/apply_temperature replacements in this file need a matching NPU gumbel_noised_argmax (tl_rand32/tl_rand64/tldevice.log1p/tl.randint) for the selector walk.

vllm_ascend/patch/worker/patch_qwen3_dflash.py — no change strictly required (DFlash2Qwen3Model/ForCausalLM inherit the monkey-patched precompute_and_store_context_kv and _read_mask_embedding from DFlashQwen3Model/ForCausalLM), but must be re-verified and extended if the new candidate_selector/DFlashGroupedConv/_grouped_conv need NPU-specific handling (torch.compile/ACL graph).
deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: This commit adds a complete new spec-decode method (DFlash2): a new draft architecture DFlash2DraftModel (vllm/model_executor/models/qwen3_dflash2.py, registered in model registry), a new V2-only speculator DFlash2Speculator with triton kernels (_selector_walk_kernel, _cache_draft_logits_kernel), a gumbel.py refactor (extracted gumbel_noised_argmax), a new LogitsProcessor.get_top_k_tokens vocab-parallel top-k path, a new DraftModelSpeculator.draft_logits_spec hook, and VllmConfig._is_dflash2_draft forcing V2 model runner. vllm-ascend maintains DFlash/DSpark spec decode in its own speculator hierarchy and patching, so it must adapt as follows: (1) In vllm_ascend/worker/v2/spec_decode/__init__.py init_speculator(), add a branch before use_dflash() that checks 'DFlash2DraftModel' in speculative_config.draft_model_config.architectures and returns an AscendDFlash2Speculator; (2) create vllm_ascend/worker/v2/spec_decode/dflash2/speculator.py with AscendDFlash2Speculator(DFlash2Speculator) replicating the AscendDFlashSpeculator overrides (build_draft_attn_metadatas with build_attn_metadata_wrapper, _update_draft_attn_metadata rebuilding actual_seq_lengths_q for padded batches, init_cudagraph_manager wiring query_cudagraph_manager.speculator/update_stream, set_attn building attn_backends + int32 context_slot_mappings, propose under build_attn_metadata_wrapper) plus NPU triton kernels for _selector_walk_kernel and _cache_draft_logits_kernel (mirroring _prepare_dflash_inputs_kernel_ascend); (3) extend DFlashAclGraphManager to capture/update DFlash2's selector buffers in run_fullgraph; (4) extend patch_dflash_speculator.py so the DFlashAclGraphManager/build_attn_metadata patch also covers the dflash2 speculator module; (5) add an NPU gumbel_noised_argmax for the selector walk (upstream refactor is behavior-preserving but the new kernel is a new NPU surface); (6) validate LogitsProcessor.get_top_k_tokens — it falls back to torch.topk when current_platform.is_cuda() is False (correct on Ascend), but the vocab-parallel top-k reduction may warrant an Ascend top-k kernel for performance; (7) confirm V2 model runner is exercised for DFlash2 (VllmConfig now forces V2; ascend's V1-default paths cannot run DFlash2) and add e2e/UT coverage analogous to tests/v1/spec_decode/test_dflash2.py.

commits.comment: 修复 DSpark 推测解码中 draft 模型 attention 后端继承范围过宽的问题。原逻辑在未显式指定 draft attention 后端时直接回退使用 target 模型的 attention 后端；现在仅当 draft 模型为 DeepSeek-V4（model_type == 'deepseek_v4'）时才继承 target 后端，其他 DSpark 架构返回 None 以重新触发后端自动选择。原因是 DeepSeek-V4 的 draft 层与 target 共享 KV cache 布局，而其他 DSpark 架构可能使用不同的 attention kind。变更将逻辑抽取为 _resolve_dspark_attention_backend 辅助函数，并延迟了 get_model 等 import。风险低，但非 DeepSeek-V4 的 DSpark 模型后端选择行为发生变化，依赖旧行为的用户需重新验证。

ascend_impact.functionality: vllm-ascend 的 spec_decode 目录包含 DSpark proposer 实现，load_dspark_model 是 DSpark draft 模型加载的公共入口。此变更将 attention 后端回退逻辑限定为仅 DeepSeek-V4（model_type == 'deepseek_v4'）继承 target 后端，其他 DSpark 架构改为返回 None 并重新触发后端自动选择。在 Ascend 平台上，非 DeepSeek-V4 的 DSpark draft 模型将不再错误继承 target 的 AscendAttentionBackend，而是通过 AscendPlatform.get_attn_backend_cls() 自动选择，行为更正确；DeepSeek-V4 DSpark 场景不受影响。

commits.comment: （自动判定）仅涉及 tests / docs / CI / 平台特化代码变更，不影响 vllm-ascend。

大型功能特性：在 OpenAI API 响应中新增 per-request 推测解码接受度指标（metrics.speculative_decoding）。实现链路：ObservabilityConfig 新增 per_request_spec_decode_metrics 配置项（none/summary/detailed）→ VllmConfig 校验该配置必须与 speculative decoding 同时启用 → Scheduler 在 add_request 时为每个 Request 创建 RequestSpecDecodeMetrics 累积器，在 update_from_output 中按 verify step 记录接受/提议的 draft token 数（并扣除 grammar-invalid 的 draft）→ 请求完成时通过 EngineCoreOutput.spec_decode_metrics 传给前端 → OutputProcessor 将其挂到 CompletionOutput → OpenAI serving 层组装为 SpeculativeDecodingMetrics 响应字段。summary 级别提供 mean_acceptance_length、draft_acceptance_rate、acceptance_histogram 等聚合值；detailed 级别额外提供 per-step 数组。同时更新 Rust engine-core-client 协议和文档。风险中等：涉及 Scheduler、EngineCoreOutput（msgspec 序列化）、Request、CompletionOutput 等多个核心数据结构扩展，但新字段均有默认值且 EngineCoreOutput 字段追加在末尾以保持 array_like 序列化兼容。

ascend_impact.functionality: 新增 ObservabilityConfig.per_request_spec_decode_metrics 配置项及 VllmConfig 校验（启用时必须同时开启 speculative decoding）。Scheduler 在 add_request 时为 Request 创建 RequestSpecDecodeMetrics 累积器，并在 update_from_output 中按 verify step 记录指标；请求完成时通过 EngineCoreOutput.spec_decode_metrics 传递。vllm-ascend 的自定义调度器（BalanceScheduler、BatchJobAwareScheduler、ShortRequestFirstScheduler、RecomputeScheduler、ProfilingChunkScheduler）继承自 vLLM Scheduler，若覆写了 add_request/update_from_output 而未调用 super()，将丢失 per-request 指标累积逻辑。EngineCoreOutput 新增字段追加在末尾，msgspec array_like 序列化兼容。
ascend_impact.testing: vllm-ascend 需要验证自定义调度器在启用 per-request-spec-decode-metrics 时仍能正确累积指标，以及 Ascend 的 spec decode 方法（Eagle/DSpark 等）产生的接受/提议 token 数能被正确统计。
suggested_test_areas: vllm_ascend/core/sched/（自定义调度器与 per-request spec decode metrics 的兼容性）
vllm_ascend/spec_decode/（推测解码接受度指标端到端验证）

commits.message:
[Frontend][Core][Spec Decode] Per-request acceptance stats in OpenAI API responses (#48915)

Signed-off-by: Matthew Kotila <7692737+matthewkotila@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Reed Meyerson <31574681+reed-meyerson@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

affected_interfaces: vllm_ascend/core/recompute_scheduler.py: RecomputeScheduler.update_from_output() — the forked copy of the upstream Scheduler spec-decode acceptance block (lines ~1082-1111) must mirror the new per-request RequestSpecDecodeMetrics.observe() accumulation added by this commit; otherwise the accumulator is never fed and the feature silently no-ops

vllm_ascend/core/recompute_scheduler.py: RecomputeScheduler.update_from_output() EngineCoreOutput(...) construction (line ~1213) — must attach spec_decode_metrics=request.spec_decode_metrics on finish, or the per-request acceptance payload never reaches the output processor / OpenAI response

vllm_ascend/core/recompute_scheduler.py: Request spec_decode_metrics attribute — the new field added to vllm.v1.request.Request (default None) is populated by the base Scheduler.add_request (inherited by all ascend schedulers); the forked update_from_output must read/observe it to stay in parity with upstream
deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: This commit adds an opt-in, experimental per-request spec-decode acceptance metric (`--per-request-spec-decode-metrics` = none/summary/detailed, default none). All changes are backward compatible (new optional fields `Request.spec_decode_metrics`, `EngineCoreOutput.spec_decode_metrics` appended last to the msgspec array_like struct, `CompletionOutput.spec_decode_metrics`, `PerRequestMetrics` rename of `PerRequestTimingMetrics`, plus `vllm/v1/metrics/stats.py::RequestSpecDecodeMetrics`). No vllm-ascend code references the renamed types, and vllm-ascend uses the Python (not Rust) frontend, so no breakage occurs. The only real integration gap is the forked scheduler: `RecomputeScheduler` (vllm_ascend/core/recompute_scheduler.py) fully overrides `update_from_output()` without calling super(), so the new accumulation logic in the upstream base `Scheduler.update_from_output()` (added right after `make_spec_decoding_stats` in the spec-decode block) and the `spec_decode_metrics` attach on finish are bypassed. Adaptation: (1) in RecomputeScheduler.update_from_output's spec-decode branch, after `self.make_spec_decoding_stats(...)`, add: if `request.spec_decode_metrics is not None`, compute `adj_draft_tokens = num_draft_tokens - scheduler_output.num_invalid_spec_tokens.get(req_id, 0)` and call `request.spec_decode_metrics.observe(num_draft_tokens=adj_draft_tokens, num_accepted=num_accepted, detailed=self.spec_decode_metrics_level == 'detailed')`; (2) in the main EngineCoreOutput(...) construction, add `spec_decode_metrics=(request.spec_decode_metrics if finish_reason is not None else None)`. Variants inheriting from RecomputeScheduler (AsyncRecomputeScheduler, DyntraLBRecomputeScheduler, AsyncDyntraLBRecomputeScheduler) are covered automatically; the other ascend schedulers (BatchJobAwareScheduler, DyntraLBScheduler, ShortRequestFirstAsyncScheduler, ProfilingChunkScheduler) use the base update_from_output/add_request and inherit the new behavior for free. No platform/worker/attention-backend changes are required.
deep_analysis.risk: low. The commit is purely additive and disabled by default, so existing vllm-ascend behavior is unaffected and no crashes are expected. If not ported, the only consequence is that enabling `--per-request-spec-decode-metrics` under RecomputeScheduler would silently return no `metrics.speculative_decoding` in the response (accumulator stays empty and is never attached to EngineCoreOutput). The port is a small, mechanical sync of ~10 lines into the forked scheduler; since the response shape is marked experimental, even skipping the feature entirely is safe for compatibility.

commits.comment: 修复 batch 中同时包含带 seed 和不带 seed 的请求时 seed 丢失的问题。原条件 len(generators) != logits.shape[0] 在部分请求带 seed 时会误判为'无 generator'而走 compiled_random_sample 快速路径，导致带 seed 请求的随机性不受控。修复后仅当 generators 为空列表时才走快速路径，否则走逐请求的 softmax + gumbel 采样路径。单行修复，风险低，但影响所有平台的采样正确性。

ascend_impact.functionality: vllm/v1/sample/ops/topk_topp_sampler.py 的采样快速路径条件从 len(generators) != logits.shape[0] 改为 not generators。Ascend 使用 vLLM 标准采样器时，混合 seeded/unseeded 请求的 batch 将正确走逐请求采样路径，不再丢失 seed；若 vllm-ascend 有自定义采样 kernel 替换此模块，需同步此修复。
